sampling: Uniform without replacement over nonempty published explanation record occurrences by a permutation of common 256-slot batches; reject padding/empty descriptions. All published batch keys, including retry batches, enter the frame.
unique_feature_assumption: Each explanation record should describe a distinct feature. Selected features are checked unique within layer; cross-batch uniqueness across the entire population was not audited. Duplicate records elsewhere could weight a feature by its multiplicity.
limitations: Transcoder labels are often much shorter than MOLT full explanations.
Different autointerpretation models, prompting and source corpora confound source comparisons.
The fixed broad A category does not establish paraphrase-invariant conceptual abstraction.
The main MOLT sample and annotations are reused unchanged.
